info.title: TPCMS API — Training & Placement Cell Management System
info.description: REST API for the TPCMS backend (student, coordinator, organization, and super-admin facing training/placement management). This specification was generated by reading the actual route/controller/validation source under `backend/src/modules/**` — not the pre-existing `backend/api_documentation.md`, which was found to be stale/incorrect in several places during generation (see "Known discrepancies with api_documentation.md" below). No backend code was changed to produce this document.

x-known-discrepancies-with-legacy-doc: POST /organizations/:id/status expects approval_id 2 (Approved) or 3 (Rejected) — the legacy doc says 1/2.

PATCH /training-applications/:training_id/students/:student_id reads status from a QUERY param (?status=approve|reject), not the request body — the legacy doc describes it as a body field re-using the create schema.
training_application_table.status_id defaults to 1 (Pending) — the legacy doc says 0.

POST /departments/register requires {department_name, name, email, password, is_active?} (name/email/password are for the coordinator account created transactionally) — the legacy doc shows only {dept_name, is_active}.
GET /masters/:type is a path parameter, not a query string (?type=) as the legacy doc shows.
POST /uploads/notes accepts a single file (field 'media', multer .single()) — the legacy doc claims multi-file support with an array response.

There is no self-service 'change my password' endpoint. The real route is POST /users/change-passwrord/:user_id (note the typo in the actual path), SuperAdmin-only, resetting a target user's password with body {password, new_password} — not {oldPassword,newPassword,confirmPassword} as the legacy doc describes.
The auth rate limit on /users/login is 50 requests/minute (the 'apiLimit' middleware) — the legacy doc claims 10/minute.

tags.name: Master Data
tags.description: Reference/lookup tables (genders, semesters, divisions, categories, skills, sectors)

post.description: Creates a user row for any role. Student self-registration is not supported elsewhere — this is the only way any account (except companies, which use /organizations) gets created.

post.summary: Log in and receive a JWT
post.description: role_id must match the account's actual role or the server returns a generic 401 ("Invalid email, password, or role") — it does not distinguish wrong-password from wrong-role in the error message. Rate limited to 50 requests/minute per IP.

data.description: Base user fields merged with role-specific profile fields (student/organization), plus auth_token, role_table, and first_login.

403.description: Organization account pending approval or rejected (Organization role only)

post.description: SuperAdmin-only. Sets a target user's password directly (not a self-service 'change my own password' flow). Note the typo in the real path segment ('passwrord').

redirect.description: Frontend URL the reset link should point to

post.summary: Reset password using a token from the forgot-password email

post.description: SuperAdmin only. Creates the user_table + student_table rows transactionally.

get.description: SuperAdmin sees all students; Coordinator sees only students in their own department (scoped server-side by their user_id — no query param needed or honored).
Student only. Returns a flattened shape with human-readable lookups (department/category/gender/semester as strings, skill as a string array) rather than nested *_table objects.

put.description: Student only. All fields optional; `skills` is a full-replace array of skill name strings (matched/created server-side, not IDs).

get.description: Accessible to the student themself, SuperAdmin, or the Coordinator of that student's department (403 otherwise). Same flattened response shape as GET /students/me.

put.description: SuperAdmin only. Same fields as self-update plus roll_no/gender_id/department_id/semester_id/name/date_of_birth. `is_graduate` is REQUIRED on every call (used as the disable/enable toggle from the frontend, sent alongside whatever else is being changed).

post.description: Public. Creates the account with approval_id=0 (Pending); the account cannot log in until a SuperAdmin approves it.

put.description: Organization role only, own account. Strict schema — only name/email/mobile_no/sector_id are accepted; there are no website/description/logo/banner columns on organization_table.

delete.description: SuperAdmin only. Despite the HTTP verb, this toggles is_active via a query param rather than deleting the record.

patch.description: SuperAdmin only. approval_id 2 = Approved, 3 = Rejected (not 1/2 as older docs claimed).

post.description: Organization, Coordinator, or SuperAdmin. creator_id is taken from the JWT.

403.description: Organization account not approved (Organization role only)

get.description: Student: active placements where the student's CGPA meets min_cgpa (real eligibility filtering, not just is_active). Organization/Coordinator/SuperAdmin: only placements THEY personally created (creator_id match) — there is no "all placements across the college" view for any role via this endpoint.
Same creator/eligibility scoping rules as GET /placements/.
Student sees their own submissions; Organization/Coordinator/SuperAdmin see applications received for placements they created.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a placement application
patch.description: Organization/Coordinator/SuperAdmin. Body `status` = "Rejected"/"rejected" triggers a rejection (status_id 3); any other value (including omitted) approves (status_id 2). There is no third "Interview"/"Selected" state on the backend.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a training application
patch.description: Organization/Coordinator/SuperAdmin. Unlike the placement-application equivalent, status is passed as a QUERY parameter (?status=approve|reject), not in the body — the body only accepts an optional `remarks` string. This asymmetry is a real backend inconsistency between the two otherwise-parallel modules, documented as-is (not something the frontend can paper over without risking a validation error).

post.summary: Create a department (with its coordinator account)
post.description: SuperAdmin only. Creates department_table + a Coordinator user_table row transactionally.

patch.summary: Update a department and its coordinator
patch.description: SuperAdmin only. Field is `name` (the coordinator's name) — not `coordinator_name`.

delete.description: SuperAdmin only. Toggles is_active via query param, same pattern as the organization equivalent.

get.description: Public/any authenticated user. Note: there is no PUT/DELETE route for notes for any role — a notice can only ever be created, never edited or deleted, once posted.

get.summary: List notices created by the current user

post.description: Public endpoint (no auth enforced at the route level). Stored under public/profile_media/.
Public endpoint. Stored under public/banner_media/. Used for both placement/training banners and (frontend-only, not backend-persisted) company banners.
Public endpoint. Single file only (field `media`) despite the field name being plural-sounding. Stored under public/notes_media/.
Public endpoint. Stored under public/resume_media/. The returned fileUrl must then be PUT to /students/me as `resume_url` to persist it — this endpoint only stores the file.

get.description: Student, Coordinator, or SuperAdmin. Response shape differs entirely by role (see schema). Note: the SuperAdmin/Coordinator "approved application percentage" fields are computed by filtering status_id === 1, which is actually the Pending status per this API's own status_id contract — a likely backend bug, flagged here for visibility only (not fixed, per the read-only/no-backend-changes constraint of this documentation task).

get.summary: Get a master/lookup table by type
get.description: Path parameter, not a query string. type ∈ {genders, semesters, divisions, categories, skills, sectors}.

bearerAuth.description: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Token is a 12-hour JWT signed by the server on login, carrying `{ auth_user_id, auth_email, auth_role_id }`.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted to perform this action

name.description: Only present via merged role-specific joins; user_table itself has no name/avatar column.

Student.description: Raw student_table row as returned by list/create/update endpoints (nested *_table relations).

StudentSelfProfile.description: Flattened shape returned only by GET /students/me and GET /students/:user_id (different from the list endpoint's nested shape).

skills.description: Full-replace list of skill name strings.

is_graduate.description: Required on every admin update call, not just when toggling disable/enable.

has_backlog.description: Whether students with active backlogs are eligible.

Application.description: Shape shared by placement_application_table and training_application_table rows.

status_id.description: 1=Pending (default), 2=Approved, 3=Rejected. No other values are ever written by the API.

student_table.description: Present when fetched by the creator (Org/Coordinator/SuperAdmin).
